symptom: My pH readings drift and the meter keeps showing the recalibration warning.
question: I switched on the pH meter and started straight away. I rinsed the probe with Millipore water, dried it with a Kimwipe, put it in the pH 4.00 buffer and clicked read. Then I rinsed the probe with Millipore water, put it in the pH 6.00 buffer and clicked read. I put the clean probe in my sample solution and clicked read. I switched off the meter, rinsed the probe and put it back in the storage solution.
